from zipfile import ZipFile, ZIP_DEFLATED
from pathlib import Path
from tempfile import NamedTemporaryFile
import shutil, xml.etree.ElementTree as ET

pptx = Path('/home/user/Desktop/154_3.pptx')
backup = pptx.with_suffix('.pptx.bak')
shutil.copy2(pptx, backup)

A = 'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/drawingml/2006/main'
NS = {
    'a': A,
    'p': 'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/presentationml/2006/main',
    'r': 'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships',
    'p14': 'http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/powerpoint/2010/main',
    'p15': 'http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/powerpoint/2012/main',
    'mc': 'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/markup-compatibility/2006',
}
for prefix, uri in NS.items():
    ET.register_namespace(prefix, uri)

slide_name = 'ppt/slides/slide1.xml'
with ZipFile(pptx, 'r') as zin:
    infos = zin.infolist()
    slide_xml = zin.read(slide_name)

root = ET.fromstring(slide_xml)

def set_text_color(props):
    props.set('u', 'sng')
    # Replace any existing text fill with dark red 2 / dark red RGB.
    for child in list(props):
        if child.tag in (f'{{{A}}}solidFill', f'{{{A}}}gradFill', f'{{{A}}}noFill'):
            props.remove(child)
    solid = ET.Element(f'{{{A}}}solidFill')
    srgb = ET.SubElement(solid, f'{{{A}}}srgbClr')
    srgb.set('val', 'C00000')
    # Put fill before font/typeface children to match DrawingML ordering.
    insert_at = 0
    for i, child in enumerate(list(props)):
        if child.tag in (f'{{{A}}}latin', f'{{{A}}}ea', f'{{{A}}}cs', f'{{{A}}}sym', f'{{{A}}}hlinkClick'):
            insert_at = i
            break
        insert_at = i + 1
    props.insert(insert_at, solid)

# Existing run and paragraph-end properties.
for tag in ('rPr', 'endParaRPr', 'defRPr'):
    for props in root.findall(f'.//a:{tag}', NS):
        set_text_color(props)

# Ensure every text run has explicit properties, in case future files have implicit formatting.
for r in root.findall('.//a:r', NS):
    rpr = r.find('a:rPr', NS)
    if rpr is None:
        rpr = ET.Element(f'{{{A}}}rPr')
        r.insert(0, rpr)
    set_text_color(rpr)

new_slide = ET.tostring(root, encoding='UTF-8', xml_declaration=True)
with NamedTemporaryFile('wb', delete=False, dir=str(pptx.parent), suffix='.pptx') as tmp:
    tmp_path = Path(tmp.name)
with ZipFile(pptx, 'r') as zin, ZipFile(tmp_path, 'w', ZIP_DEFLATED) as zout:
    for info in zin.infolist():
        data = new_slide if info.filename == slide_name else zin.read(info.filename)
        zout.writestr(info, data)
shutil.move(tmp_path, pptx)
print(f'Updated {pptx}')
print(f'Backup: {backup}')
PY"
